# AnyScan209

> AnyScan209 is a free, ad-free, and privacy-focused Android application designed to transform smartphones into powerful 4-in-1 data visualization and telemetry tools for internal sensors and external microcontrollers.

## Project Overview
- **Developer:** Saeid Moghadam
- **Primary Purpose:** 2D and 3D data visualization for geophysical mapping, metal/cavity detection, barometric tracking, light/sound metering, and external IoT/Bluetooth sensor telemetry.
- **Platforms:** Android (App) & Web Documentation (GitHub Pages / HTML5).

## Core Features
1. **Internal Sensors:**
   - **Magnetometer:** Geophysical surveys, metal detection, finding buried objects and AC live wires behind walls.
   - **Barometer / Altimeter:** Surface elevation and topographic mapping.
   - **Light Meter:** Ambient illumination (lux) tracking for agriculture and environments.
   - **Sound Meter:** Noise and acoustic level analysis.
2. **External Sensor Support:**
   - Bluetooth Serial (SPP) integration for custom microcontrollers (Arduino, ESP32, ATmega) sending 0-1024 data values.
3. **Visualization & Export:**
   - 2D and 3D terrain/grid rendering (from 8x8 up to 100x100 grid points).
   - Over 43 customizable topographic color palettes.
   - Export capabilities to standard formats: **CSV** (for MATLAB/Excel), **OBJ** (3D models), and **STL** (3D printing).

## Technical Architecture & Files
- **App Development:** Built for Android (compatible with custom mobile frameworks and native integrations).
- **Web Interface:** Single-page application documentation (`index.html`) featuring setup guides, code examples (Arduino/BASCOM equivalents), and FAQs.
- **Privacy Policy:** 100% offline-first processing capability, no user data collection, no ads.
